cases.given: An empty local installation and a known Firebase uid
cases.when: Bootstrap a workspace and sign in
then: Only workspace and membership records exist.
Setup UI reports zero business records.
Restart preserves identity and does not add fixtures.

cases.given: Two workspaces, each with ADMIN and REP users
cases.when: Access foreign IDs and invoke an admin command as a rep
then: No cross-workspace data is returned.
Foreign resource lookup returns 404; absent membership/admin privilege returns 403.
Unauthorized requests cause no mutation.

cases.given: An empty authorized workspace
cases.when: Create a store, distributor and arbitrary products, edit and reload
then: Records persist through restart.
Store creation creates exactly one backroom.
Shared distributor stock is not copied to stores.
No particular SKU/store code is required.

cases.given: Catalog records referenced by policies and reports
cases.when: Archive a referenced active product or a store
then: Product archive is rejected while an active policy requires it.
An archived store cannot start a visit.
Historic reports still resolve their source references.

cases.given: Prepared media uploads
cases.when: Complete valid, oversize, checksum-mismatched and mis-typed uploads
then: Only validated bytes become READY.
Type/size/checksum failures are explicit.
URLs expire and foreign users cannot obtain them.
Correct media is bound to its visit/product and zone.

cases.given: A new catalog and valid sales/stock CSVs
cases.when: Validate, inspect results and explicitly commit
then: Validation alone adds no analytical facts.
Commit makes the entire valid batch visible.
Units/currency/case normalization match the import contract.

cases.given: CSV with one unknown SKU, duplicate key, missing column or invalid number
cases.when: Run validation
then: Import is INVALID with row/field errors.
No facts are committed.
Correcting the file requires a new upload; no implicit product is created.

cases.given: A committed batch and an existing investigation snapshot
cases.when: Retry the commit and then commit a correcting file
then: The same batch/hash is not duplicated.
Latest keyed revision affects new snapshots only.
Old investigation evidence and metrics remain unchanged.

cases.given: An uploaded agreement and catalog
cases.when: Extract proposed rules
then: A draft with page/quote evidence and unresolved gaps is produced.
No policy becomes approved automatically.
A manual correction is explicitly marked MANUAL.

cases.given: Two admins reading the same draft version
cases.when: Both approve different revisions
then: Exactly one current-version approval succeeds.
The stale approval returns 409.
Approved versions and their rules remain immutable.

cases.given: An active store
cases.when: Create an open visit, edit notes and finalize before media
then: Visit and media IDs are persisted and related correctly.
Media from another store or visit cannot be submitted.
Refreshing restores the same visit.

cases.given: Imported data, an approved policy and ready visit images with arbitrary IDs
cases.when: Start and finish an investigation
then: Tools read repository data and the captured batch/policy/media versions.
Job progress corresponds to actual stages.
Proposal contains a hypothesis, evidence-linked claims, alternatives and no more than three tasks.

cases.given: Missing sales rows, stale stock or a partial image zone
cases.when: Calculate metrics and analyze evidence
then: Missing is not zero and out-of-view is not absent.
Unavailable metrics are null with reasons.
Unknown backroom stock yields a check request, not asserted replenishability.

cases.given: Small factory-generated complete windows and eligible/ineligible peers
cases.when: Compute all commercial metrics
then: Decimal results follow peer_gap_v1 with one final HALF_UP rounding.
Fewer than three eligible peers and zero denominators return null.
Peer cohort excludes focal store and mismatched retailer/region/format/promotion/currency.

cases.given: A model proposal with good, invented and cross-scope evidence IDs
cases.when: Validate and retrieve claims/evidence
then: Invented/out-of-scope references are rejected.
Accepted claims resolve to immutable PDF/image/row locators.
Metric text cannot conflict with the computed Metrics DTO.

cases.given: A current proposed plan
cases.when: Accept twice with the same key, then change key/body or submit a stale version
then: Exactly one action set is created.
Same key/body replays the original response.
Changed body or stale version returns 409.
Claimed completion cannot set VERIFIED or RESOLVED.

cases.given: An accepted plan and clear new evidence satisfying every frozen rule
cases.when: Run verification
then: Every rule is checked once.
Code derives PASS.
Actions, visit closure and saved report update once atomically.

cases.given: Partial fixes, no display view, occlusion, or ambiguous product identity
cases.when: Verify the rules
then: Any unknown yields INCONCLUSIVE; other aggregates follow the contract.
No false PASS or visit closure occurs.
Response identifies remaining work or a specific retake.

cases.given: Old, reused, future-dated or incorrectly bound after media
cases.when: Submit verification
then: Replay/timestamp/scope checks reject ineligible evidence.
Metadata checks are not represented as proof of physical authenticity.

cases.given: Concurrent accept/verify commands and duplicate worker delivery
cases.when: Race the operations
then: Only the current plan can close.
No duplicate actions/reports occur.
Lease fencing prevents an expired worker from writing terminal state.

cases.given: A persisted job with failed dispatch or a crash after a checkpoint/commit
cases.when: Restart, drain outbox and deliver duplicates
then: Job remains discoverable after disconnect/restart.
Outbox re-enqueues safely.
Committed imports are reconciled without duplicate facts.
A model call may repeat, but final business writes do not.

cases.given: Provider timeout, quota failure and exhausted budgets
cases.when: Run and retry a job
then: Attempts and costs are recorded.
Permanent errors do not retry indefinitely.
Failure returns an explicit incomplete/needs-work result, never fabricated success.

cases.given: A workspace with no stores or commercial data
cases.when: Use every setup/management route
then: Useful empty states and creation/import actions exist.
No sample dashboard values appear.
Missing, zero, stale and loading states are visibly distinct.

cases.given: The backend modules integrated with the generated web client
cases.when: Complete setup and rep workflow at desktop and 375 px widths, including refresh
then: All required routes use live API state.
The user can recover validation/conflict/inconclusive errors.
Evidence navigation and saved reports work with keyboard and phone layout.

cases.given: The canonical OpenAPI and AI schemas
cases.when: Generate types and validate request/response examples plus real handlers
then: No unexplained contract drift or duplicate shadow DTOs.
Unknown fields, malformed IDs and illegal enum values fail validation.
Clients understand null and error envelopes.

cases.given: Local and cloud configurations
cases.when: Start cloud mode with test providers/emulator settings and local mode without demo seed
then: Cloud mode refuses stub/emulator configuration.
Local mode is labeled accurately.
Runtime imports contain no demo fixtures/evaluation labels.
An empty local start succeeds without a seed.

cases.given: The same small dataset in local analytics and disposable BigQuery adapters
cases.when: Run import correction, coverage, freshness and metric queries
then: Results and null/error semantics match.
Cloud import transaction and authorization checks pass.
Cloud data is isolated from production and cleaned only via an explicit disposable-target command.

cases.given: Frozen 20-case holdout and recorded model settings
cases.when: Run three repeats and baseline comparisons
then: Publish actual label counts and evidence support.
Meet diagnosis/false-resolution criteria or record an explicit blocked/reduced-scope release.
No test-double run or edited holdout is substituted for live evaluation.

cases.given: An authorized empty development project
cases.when: Apply deployment configuration, bootstrap and exercise jobs/media
then: Services, indexes, authentication and private worker work from repeatable instructions.
No business records are preloaded.
Logs expose correlation/errors without secrets.
Restart/outbox recovery works in the deployed environment.

cases.given: A complete core MVP and an explicit target workspace
cases.when: Run optional seed-demo twice, then load differently named data
then: Seed uses normal services/imports and is idempotent.
No runtime code depends on its values.
Regression factories work without the demo seed.

cases.given: A fresh workspace unrelated to demo identifiers
cases.when: Follow the README to load inputs and complete the entire workflow
then: A user can populate the app through its interfaces without direct database edits.
The investigation and report reflect those inputs.
The repository includes actual local/cloud/live acceptance evidence and limitations.

cases.given: PDF, visit note or image text trying to override tools/policy
cases.when: Run extraction/investigation/verification
then: Source text is treated as data, not authority.
No arbitrary URL/SQL, state mutation or expanded access occurs.
Citations still reference eligible evidence.

cases.given: Invalid model JSON, unknown products, duplicate checks and unsupported PASS
cases.when: Validate output and attempt one repair
then: Only supported provider schema conversion is sent.
Strict application and semantic validation still runs.
A second invalid output ends incomplete without closing the case.

cases.given: An accepted plan whose approved policy is replaced or archived
cases.when: Accept or verify its stale version
then: Return 409 STALE_POLICY and require a new investigation.
No obsolete plan closes current work.
Existing resolved reports remain historical and readable.

cases.given: Policies referencing too many, archived or unknown products
cases.when: Approve/start an investigation
then: Catalog constraints produce actionable errors.
No silent reference truncation or hardcoded SKU fallback occurs.

cases.given: Canonical schemas and an empty implementation scaffold
cases.when: Pin dependencies, run full schema validators and generate types
then: Schema examples and references validate.
Generation is deterministic and drift is detected.
No real-handler or live-provider acceptance is claimed yet.

cases.given: Empty emulators and the core ports/services with a test-only worker handler
cases.when: Exercise identity scope, repository transactions, blob primitives, outbox dispatch, lease fencing and restart
then: Membership/role checks deny invalid scope.
State and outbox persist and duplicate delivery cannot duplicate the test effect.
Blob primitives verify byte/hash constraints.
No catalog/import/AI endpoint or business seed is required for this foundation gate.

cases.given: Generated client and contract-shaped component inputs, including empty and invalid states
cases.when: Render and operate management screens with explicitly isolated API doubles
then: Requests conform to the frozen contract.
Empty/loading/validation/conflict states and accessible controls work.
Tests identify mocks and do not claim connected backend acceptance.

cases.given: Model gateway and tool ports with deterministic test responses
cases.when: Extract images/PDFs, synthesize evidence-bound proposals and validate malformed/injection responses
then: Model and tool schemas, scope and allowed-call limits are enforced.
Arbitrary product IDs work and ungrounded references are rejected.
No policy approval, action acceptance or verified-resolution claim is possible at this layer.
A separate live provider probe is reported honestly when credentials exist.

cases.given: Integrated catalog, imports, policies and investigation services; verifier contract fixed
cases.when: Complete actual management and investigation/acceptance flow and render verification/report components
then: Setup through plan acceptance uses real integrated services.
Verification components are explicitly contract-tested until T09 integrates.
Full verification/browser acceptance AC24 and AC31 remain pending for T10/T14.

cases.given: An explicitly authorized empty cloud development project and T01 foundation
cases.when: Deploy infrastructure, health/auth endpoints and a test-only queue/worker smoke handler
then: Private worker IAM, outbox schedule, indexes, bucket and dataset exist reproducibly.
No business fixtures are created.
Health/auth/dispatch smoke checks pass; complete application acceptance AC29 remains pending for T12.
